title: Data Density Scaling Laws for Image Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19013v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current scaling law formulations suggest that increasing the number of unique samples in a dataset improves model performance, while repeated exposure to the same samples provides diminishing value. In this work, we examine this assumption for image self-distillation models. Through systematic experiments across diverse datasets, namely Maxar, SATLAS, Waymo, nuPlan, Ego4D, ImageNet, and YFCC15M, we demonstrate that the effects of sample repetition on downstream performance are non-trivial and dataset-dependent. We identify settings where repeatedly training on a smaller random subset can outperform training on a larger set of unique samples. This finding highlights a limitation of existing scaling laws. To address this gap, we propose a modified version of a Chinchilla-style scaling law that explicitly accounts for two factors: the number of unique samples and repetition per sample. translated_title: 图像自蒸馏的数据密度缩放定律
translated_abstract: 当前的缩放定律表述认为，增加数据集中独特样本的数量能够提升模型性能，而对相同样本的重复接触所带来的价值会逐渐递减。在本工作中，我们针对图像自蒸馏模型检验了这一假设。通过在多个不同数据集（即 Maxar、SATLAS、Waymo、nuPlan、Ego4D、ImageNet 和 YFCC15M）上进行系统性实验，我们证明样本重复对下游性能的影响并非微不足道，而是依赖于具体的数据集。我们发现在某些设置下，在较小的随机子集上重复训练的效果可以超过在更大的独特样本集上训练的效果。这一发现凸显了现有缩放定律的局限性。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了一个改进版的 Chinchilla 风格缩放定律，该定律明确考虑了两个因素：独特样本的数量以及每个样本的重复次数。这一公式为理解该现象提供了一个框架。
tldr: 本文发现图像自蒸馏中样本重复的收益依赖于具体数据集，小数据集重复训练甚至可能优于大数据集，并提出同时考虑独特样本数量与每样本重复次数的改进版 Chinchilla 缩放定律。
